de'ang jo bo nyid kyis gzhan la rjes su gdams shing byin gyis brlabs pa las skyes pa'i slob ma rgya gar dang*/ bal bod rnams su dpag tu med par byon pa las/ jo bo rang dang mkhyen pa mnyam zhing dbu dang spyan dang phyag g.yas pa dang phyag g.yon pa lta bu'i sras kyi thu bo rnams ni paṇ+ḍi ta pi to ba dang*/ rat+nā ka ra dang*/ sa'i snying po dang*/ bshes gnyen gsang ba dang*/ dbu ma seng ge'am dharmā ka ra ma ti la sogs pa dang*/ bod na mnga' ris stod du lha btsun byang chub 'od dang*/ lo chen rin chen bzang po dang*/ nag tsho tshul khrims rgyal ba dang*/ rma dge ba'i blo gros la sogs pa dang*/ gtsang du 'brog mi shākya ye shes dang*/ gos khug pa lhas btsas dang*/ ling lo tsā ba dang*/ mgar dge ba dang*/ se ston sgra gcan 'dzin la sogs pa dang*/ dbus su khu rngog 'brom gsum dang*/ lho brag tu rnal 'byor pa chag khri mchog dang*/ dge ba skyong dang*/ khams su phyag dar ston pa ste pha rol tu phyin pa'i ṭī ka khams lugs su grags pa'i mdzad pa po de dang*/ rnal 'byor pa chen po lung a mi byang chub dang*/ dgon pa ba 'dzing sgom dbang phyug rgyal mtshan dang*/ gsang phur 'od du yal ba'i rnal 'byor pa shes rab la sogs pa rnams byon pa las/ bka' gdams kyi phrin las bskyang ba'i brgyud 'dzin chen po ni/ gsang ba'i bdag po'i rnam par 'phrul pa khu ston brtson 'grus g.yung drung dang*/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi rnam par 'phrul pa rngog legs pa'i shes rab dang*/ spyan ras gzigs kyi rnam par 'phrul pa 'brom ston rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas te gsum gyi phyi ma ni sangs rgyas phal po che'i mdo las/ byang phyogs su dge bsnyen chos 'phel zhes bya ba 'byung zhes pa dang*/ snying rje pad+ma dkar po las/ der dge bsnyen chos 'phel zhes bya ba rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa 'byung zhes dang*/ 'phags ma sgrol mas jo bo la bod du byon na phan thogs pa 'ong zhing*/

khyad par u pa si ka cig la phan thogs pa 'ong zhes bya ba'i lung gis rjes su bstan pa ste/ deng 'dir bka' gdams bstan pa'i bdag po jo bo yab sras gnyis zhes pa'i thugs sras kyi byang chub sems dpa' chen po ni 'di nyid do// gang gis legs par gsungs pa'i bdud rtsis nye bar bskyed pa ni dge ba'i bshes gnyen phu chung ba dang*/ spyan snga ba dang*/ pu to ba rin chen gsal la sogs pa dang rjes su 'jug pa mkhas shing btsun pa dang bzang po'i yon tan gyis mngon par phyug pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po mang du byon pa rnams kyis phrin las kyi 'khor lo shin tu dar bar byas so// 'on kyang da lta ni bka' gdams pa'i grub mtha' logs su gyur pa med kyang gdams ngag gi brgyud pa phal che ba dag sa dge bkar gsum gyi nang du 'dres te mi nub par skyong ba 'di ltar nyid do// rnying ma pa'i lugs srol ni/ gsang sngags kyi theg pa snga 'gyur dang phyi 'gyur gyi dbang las gsar rnying gnyis su 'byed pa'i phyi ma ste/ de'ang thog mar srong btsan sgam po'i ring la rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta byon pa rnams dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba rnams kyis thugs rje chen po'i mdo rgyud mang po bod du bsgyur ba dang*/ rgyal pos slob ma skal ba dang ldan pa rnams la gsang sngags kyi lha zhi khro rnams kyi gdams ngag sna tshogs pa bstan pas dus der dngos grub thob pa'i skyes bu'ang mang du byung zhing*/ de nas brtsams te mes ag tshom yan chad la gsang ba sngags kyi skor nyams su lon pa mang tsam byung ba dang*/ bod 'bangs gzhan thams cad kyang spyan ras gzigs la gsol ba 'debs pa dang yi ge drug pa 'don pa tsam ni kun la dar ro// de nas khri srong lde'u btsan gyi dus su dbas mañju shrīs kri yog sde gsum gyi nyan bshad dar bar mdzad pa dang*/ khyad par slob dpon chen po pad+ma sam+bha was rnal 'byor bla na med pa gtso bor gyur pa'i dbang bskur ba dang rgyud bshad pa dang gdams ngag bstan pa dang*/

chos kyi gter dang nor gyi gter gzhug pa la sogs pas gsang sngags kyi chos shin tu dar bar mdzad do// phyis su 'dul ba la sogs pa'i bstan pa la 'phel 'grib cher byung mod kyi/ gsang sngags bla med kyi bstan pa ni ma nub par bzhugs par bshad do// 'di dag gi skabs su dar ba'i rgyud ni gsang ba 'dus pa dang*/ zla gsang thig le la sogs pa'i tan+t+ra sde bco brgyad du grags pa rnams te/ khyad par nyams su spyad pa sgrub pa chen po bka' brgyad ni 'jam dpal sku la sogs pa'i 'jig rten las 'das pa'i sde lnga dang*/ ma mo rbod gtong la sogs pa 'jig rten pa'i sde gsum ste/ de las phur pa dang rta mgrin gnyis ni slob dpon chen po nyid kyis rgyal po la stsal bas rgyal pos dpal rta mgrin grub ste rta mgrin gyis rta skad 'tsher ba thos pa mang po byung zhing*/ phur pa ni jo mo dang 'bre a tsa ra sa le la stsal bas de dag las rim gyis 'phel lo// de bzhin du 'jam dpal gyi skor ni slob dpon shān+tiṃ gar+bha dang*/ yang dag gi skor ni hūm̐ kā ra dang*/ bdud rtsi'i skor ni bi ma la mi tra rnams kyis bshad cing dar bar byas so// ma mo la sogs pa ni slob dpon gyis bod kyi lha 'dre gdug pa can btul ba rnams dbang bskur te dam tshig la bzhag nas ris su bcad pa'i sde gsum po 'jig rten pa la phan gdags pa'i rtsa lag tu sgrub pa'i thabs kyi rim pa bstan pa rnams yin no// 'dus pa mdo ni dgongs pa 'dus pa ste/ 'di ni gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes kyis rgya gar dang bru sha'i yul la sogs pa na bzhugs pa'i mkhas pa rnams bsten cing*/ bru sha'i slob dpon che btsan skyes dang bcas te dgongs pa 'dus pa bod skad du bsgyur ba dang nyan bshad kyi sgo nas dar bar byas so// gsang ba'i snying po la sogs pa sgyu 'phrul rgyan gyi skor ni dri med bshes gnyen dang rma rin chen mchog gis bsgyur cing bshad pas dar bar gyur pa'o// man ngag rdzogs pa chen po sems sde dang*/

klong sde dang*/ man ngag gi sde gsum gyi dang po gnyis ni bai ro tsa na dang*/ phyi ma ni bi ma la mi tra las byung ba'i man ngag tu bshad do// de lta bu'i gsang sngags 'di dag bslab pa las byung ba'i grub pa brnyes pa'ang sngon gyi dus su rje 'bangs nyi shu rtsa lnga la sogs pa mang du byon pa rnams dang*/ de dag gi rjes su 'jug pa'i bka' gter gyi brgyud pa 'dzin pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis shin tu dar zhing rgyas par byas so// rje btsun sa skya pa ni 'og tu bshad par bya'o// mar pa las brgyud pa'i phyag rgya pa'am sgrub brgyud pa'i lugs srol ni/ skad gnyis smra ba'i dbang phyug lho brag mar pa chos kyi blo gros kyis 'phags pa'i yul du lan gsum du byon/ bla ma brgya rtsa brgyad tsam bsten te/ 'khor lo bde mchog dang gsang ba 'dus pa la sogs pa'i rgyud sde dang*/ smin byed dang grol byed kyi gdams pa dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te/ bod yul du bsgyur bshad kyi phrin las yang dag pas gtan la phab bo// gsung las skyes pa'i slob bu grangs med pa byon pa'i nang nas gtso bor gyur pa ni bka' chen bzhi ste/ de'ang 'pho ba rgya mthongs kha phye ba las bya 'phur ba lta bu'i bka' babs dol gyi mtshur ston dbang nge*/ rgyud bshad thabs kyi man ngag mu tig bstar la brgyus pa lta bu'i bka' babs gzhung gi rngog ston chos rdor/ 'od gsal mun nang mar me sbar ba lta bu'i bka' babs gtsang rong gi mes ston tshon po/ gtum mo shing gshags la me sbar ba lta bu'i bka' babs gung thang gi mid la ras pa ste/ de dag las dang po gsum gyis rgyud bshad pa'i srol bskyangs shing*/ mid las grub pa'i dbang phyug gi sar gshegs nas sgrub brgyud kyi bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan bzung ste slob ma mang du bskrun pa'i chos brgyud 'dzin pa'i slob ma'i gtso bo ni ras chung pa dang*/ dwags po lha rje gnyis te/

dang pos ni rgya gar du byon te lus med mkha' 'gro'i chos skor gyi lhag ma spyan drangs pa dang*/ ras chung snyan brgyud la sogs pa'ang de nyid nas dar bar mdzad do// phyi mas ni thog mar dbu ru phyogs su byon te bya yul ba dang*/ snyug rum pa dang*/ lcags ri gong kha ba rnams las bka' gdams kyi chos la gsan sbyangs mthar phyin par mdzad/ phyis su mid la las zab chos kyi gdams pa gsan te dgas la sgam po'i dgon pa btab nas der bzhugs pas de skad du grags so// slob ma'i tshogs la bka' gdams kyi chos dang phyag rgya chen po'i gdams pa rgya cher spel ba'i phrin las rab tu rgyas par gyur te bka' phyag chu bo gnyis 'dres su grags pa'ang 'di nyid nas byung zhing*/ bka' brgyud thams cad kyi byung khungs chen po yin no// rjes su gdams pa'i slob ma brgyud 'dzin gyi bu chen ni/ dwags po sgom tshul dang*/ phag mo gru pa ste khams pa rdor rgyal dang*/ grub thob dbu se ste dus gsum mkhyen pa dang*/ 'ba' dom ras pa la sogs pa'o// phag gru ni thog mar dbus kyi stod lung rgya dmar la sogs pa las dbu tshad dang*/ gtsang du las stod dkon mchog mkhar dang*/ sa skya pa chen po dang*/ byang sems zla ba rgyal mtshan dang*/ dmar chos kyi rgyal po la sogs pa las zab chos kyi gsan sbyangs mdzad pas nyams rtogs khyad par can rgyud la 'khrungs/ phyis su dwags po lha rje'i zhabs bsten te de'i zab chos kyi bdag por gyur to// de nyid kyi rjes su gdams pa las skyes pa'i slob ma'i gtso bo ni gling ras dang*/ 'bri khung skyur rin chen dpal dang*/ stag lung bkra shis dpal dang*/ khro phu ba la sogs pa'o// gling ras kyi slob ma gtsang pa rgya ras ye shes rdo rje'o// de'i slob ma ni rgod tshang pa dang*/ lo ras pa dang*/ dbon sras la sogs pa ste/ de gsum so so las mched pa la stod smad bar gyi 'brug pa rnams te/

de dag las rim gyis byung ba'i rang rang gi srol 'dzin rnams kyis mi nub par skyong bar byed do// dam pa'i chos sdug bsngal zhi bar byed pa'i bka' srol ni/ grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po dam pa sangs rgyas kyis yongs su dar bar bgyis te/ 'di la brgyud pa snga phyi bar gsum gyi brgyud pa dang po ni/ dam pa rgya gar gyis kha che dz+nyā na gu h+ya la bshad pa'i zhi byed sgron ma skor gsum la sogs pa rnams te/ de rnams dam pa dang kha che ba gnyis kas ang po lo tsā ba la bshad pa dang*/ kha che bas pu hrangs lo chung la'ang bshad de/ des dmar ston chos kyi rgyal po la sogs pa la bshad do// brgyud pa bar ma ni dam pas bod la lan lngar byon pa'i bzhi pa'i dus su rma chos kyi shes rab dang*/ so dge 'dun 'bar dang*/ kam ye shes rgyal mtshan gsum la bshad do// brgyud pa phyi ma ni lan lnga par ding ri la byon pa'i dus su dam pa phyar chen dang phyar chung dang*/ badz+ra kro dha dang*/ dam pa kun dga' la sogs pa la gsungs nas rim gyis dar ro// de nas brgyud pa'i gcod kyi skor ni/ dam pa bod du lan gsum par byon pa'i dus su yar lungs pa'i smar ser po dang*/ skyo ston bsod nams bla ma la bshad de/ de nas brgyud pa la pho gcod ces grags pa dang*/ ma gcig gis dam pa dang skyo ston gnyis ka las gsan te/ de nas brgyud pa la mo gcod ces grags so// dpal ldan shangs pa bka' brgyud pa'i lugs srol ni/ khyung po rnal 'byor gyis rgya gar du byon te rdo rje gdan pa dang*/ mai tri pa dang*/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma ni gu ma la sogs pa'i bla ma brgya dang lnga bcu lhag pa las chos gsan te thugs nyams su bstar/ bod du byon te shangs gzhong gzhong gi dgon pa btab pas shangs pa bka' brgyud ces bya bar grags shing*/ 'di la slob ma la stod dkon mchog mkhar dang*/ rmog cog pa la sogs pa khri phrag brgyad du langs pa byung bar grags so// man ngag sbyor drug sogs ni bod du thog mar dpal chen rga lo dang*/

grub thob yu mo yab sras dang*/ bu dol la sogs pas dar bar mdzad do// ri bo dga' ldan pa'i lugs srol ni/ shar btsong kha pa chen po blo bzang grags pa'i dpal gyi rjes su 'jug pa dang bcas pa ste/ rje btsun dam pa 'di ni 'jam dpal rtsa ba'i rgyud dang*/ mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i rgyud dang*/ bka' gdams glegs bam rin po che la sogs pa'i bka' dang bstan bcos mang po nas lung bstan cing*/ sngon gyi dus su de bzhin gshegs pa dbang po'i tog gi drung du thugs bskyed cing*/ ma 'ongs pa na sangs rgyas kyi zhing dpag tu med pa 'das pa'i mtshams su ngo mtshar rmad byung bkod pa sna tshogs pas mdzes pa zhes bya ba'i zhing khams su/ de bzhin gshegs pa seng ge'i nga ro zhes bya bar 'tshang rgya bar lung bstan pa'i skyes bu dam pa ste/ rje btsun dam pa 'dis sku tshe'i stod du mdo sngags dang rig pa'i gtsug lag gangs can gyi ljongs su dar ba phal cher gyi gsan pa dang sbyangs pa rgya mtsho chen po lta bu'i pha rol tu phyin par mdzad do// bar skabs su thos pa'i don la dpyad pa dang bsgom pa'i sgo nas nyams su bzhes pa kho na lhur mdzad cing*/ 'phral gyi kun du spyod pa rnams kyang 'dul ba dang mthun pa'i lag len gyi gsos btab bo// khyad par rgyal ba'i gsung rab mdo rgyud ma lus pa'i snying po bsdus pa/ shing rta chen po klu sgrub dang thogs med gnyis kyi lam srol/ skyes bu gsum gyis nyams su blang bar bya ba'i rim pa thams cad tshang bar ston par byed pa byang chub lam gyi rim pa gtso bor gyur pa'i bstan pa rgyas pa'i phrin las skyong ba la 'bad pa rtse gcig tu bton pas/ dpal ldan 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyang dges pas zhal gzigs pa la/ bla ma dbu ma pas lo tsā ba mdzad pa'i tshul gyis mdo dang sngags kyi chos mang po la the tshom gyi mdud pa grol bar byas so// sku tshe'i smad du 'gro don dang phrin las rmad du byung bar rgyas par gyur te lha ldan du cho 'phrul dus chen gyi smon lam chen po tshugs pa dang*/

'brog ri bo dga' ldan rnam rgyal gling btab pas/ de nas brtsams te de'i rjes su 'jug pa dang bcas pa la dga' ldan pa zhes yongs su grags pa byung ngo*// de nyid kyi gsung gi bdud rtsi 'thung ba las skyes pa'i slob ma grangs med pa byung ba las mchog tu gyur pa ni rgyal tshabs rje dang*/ mkhas grub rje dang*/ thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub pa dang*/ 'dul 'dzin grags rgyal dang*/ 'dul 'dzin blo gros sbas pa ste 'dul ba 'dzin pa rnam pa gnyis la sogs pa mkhas pa'i phrin las la dbang 'byor ba mang du byon pa rnams kyis phrin las kyi rgyun gnas par byed do// rje btsun sa skya pa'i lugs srol ni/ thog mar 'khon klu'i dbang po'i bsrungs pas sad mi mi bdun gyi nang gses su rab tu byung ste/ slob dpon pad+ma sam+bha wa'i zhabs kyi pad+mar brten te gsang sngags kyi smin byed dang grol byed kyi gdams pa mang du gsan cing*/ dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu la sogs pa'i gsang sngags kyi bka' babs shing grub pa brnyes so// de nas bzung ste 'khon rog shes rab tshul khrims yan chad la gsang sngags rnying ma'i grub pa brnyes pa sha stag byung ngo*// ji tsam zhig na 'khon rog gi gcung du gyur pa dkon mchog rgyal pos dbang phyug ma nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyi gar 'cham byed pa la sogs pa gzigs pa'i rkyen gyis/ gsang sngags gsar ma la 'jug pa'i sgo bye ste/ rnying ma'i chos skor yang phur gnyis tsam min pa'i phal che ba gter du sbas nas/ bla chen 'brog mi lo tsā la sogs pa'i mkhas grub kyi 'khor los sgyur ba du ma'i zhabs bsten nas thos bsam bsgom pa rgya mtsho lta bu'i mthar son par mdzad do// sa dkar po'i logs la sā lu'i sman ljongs kyi rdo rje'i gdan chen po dpal ldan sa skya'i chos grwa chen po 'di nyid skye dgu ma lus pa'i bsod nams kyi dpyid du bskrun te/

de phyin chad nas lha rigs 'khon sa skya pa zhes yongs su grags so// de'i sras 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug gis 'gro ba'i don la bsam bzhin du skye ba'i sgyu 'phrul gyi rol pa dpal brtse ba chen po kun dga' snying po ste/ rje btsun dam pa 'dis lhag pa'i lha 'jam pa'i dbyangs bsgrubs pas zla ba drug nas lhag pa lha'i zhal gyi dkyil 'khor mthong zhing*/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i lugs kyi lam yongs su rdzogs par ston par byed pa'i zhen pa bzhi bral gyi gdams pa'i lam srol chen po stsal to// de nas brtsams te bka' sde snod kyi chos thams cad la mi 'jigs pa med pa'i spobs pa brnyes nas rim gyis brang ti dar ma snying po dang*/ khyung rin chen grags dang*/ mes lhang tsher dang*/ kha'u pa dar ma rgyal mtshan dang*/ sgyi chu ba dgra lha 'bar dang*/ mal lo tsā ba dang*/ pu hrangs lo chung la sogs pa las mdo sngags kyi chos tshul bsam gyis mi khyab pa gsan te bstan pa'i bdag por gyur to// khyad par bla chen zhang dgon pa ba yun ring du brten te/ dpal ldan bir+wa pa'i bzhed gzhung gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdams ngag yan lag dang bcas pa gsan cing thugs nyams su bstar ro// dpal rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug gtso 'khor lnga dam pa'i chos sgo skyel gyi tshul du byon nas/ rgyud sde bdun cu rtsa gnyis dang*/ lcags ri'i khong las mi 'da' ba'i zab chos bzhi la sogs pa dang*/ gsung ngag rin po che nye brgyud kyi gdams pa ma lus pa stsal to// rang lo lnga bcu par gdams ngag gi bka' rgya grol te/ khams pa a seng gis zhus pa'i ngor gsung ngag thog mar gsungs pa nas bzung ste gdams pa rnams legs par stsal ba'i slob ma mchog thob pa gsum/ bzod pa thob pa bdun/ rtogs pa ldan pa brgyad cu/ gzhung bshad 'dzin pa'i thugs sras bcu gcig tshig rkang rnam par 'grel pa'i thugs sras bdun/

phyogs kyi mkhas grub chen po bzhi la sogs pa rnams so// de'i sras rje btsun mched gnyis zhes pa ni 'phags pa'i yul gyi paṇ+ḍi ta chen po mi thub zla ba'i rnam par 'phrul ba slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo dang*/ skye ba du mar rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs lhag pa'i lhar gyur pas skye ba 'dir 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa thugs la rang rdol du byung ba la sogs pa'i yon tan rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan dang*/ chos rje khu dbon zhes pa mkhyen rab 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang gnyis su med pas/ gangs can gyi ljongs su bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas kyi bstan pa yongs su rdzogs pa gsal bar byed pa'i thog mar gyur pa sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta dang*/ lung rtogs kyi yon tan phun sum tshogs pa'i rtags su/ dbu dang phyag zhabs rnams so sor phral te de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i dkyil 'khor du sprul pa dang bsdu bas sa'i steng gi 'gro ba rgya mtsho dad par byas te/ mdo sngags chos kyi snang bar byed po 'gro ba'i mgon po 'phags pa rin po che ste/ dpal sa skya'i rje btsun gong ma lnga zhes yongs su grags so// 'di dag gis stobs bcu mnga' ba'i bstan pa la lhag pa'i bya ba byas pa dang che ba'i yon tan mdor bsdus pa rtogs par 'dod pa rnams kyis dpal sa skya'i rje btsun gong ma lnga'i gsung rab rin po che'i par gyi sgo 'phar 'byed pa'i dkar chag 'phrul gyi lde mig tu 'khod pa la sogs par shes par bya ba las 'dir ma spros so// ji skad smos pa'i rje btsun rnam pa lnga po de dag gi bstan pa ma lus pa phyogs bcu kun du gsal bar byed pa'i bstan skyong gi skyes bu chen po bgrang gis mi ldang bar byon zhing*/ bye brag tu 'dzam gling byang phyogs kyi nor 'dzin dga' ma'i dkyil 'khor kun du nyi ma dang*/ zla ba ltar yongs su grags shing*/ rgyal ba dgyes pa'i phrin las 'chad rtsod rtsom pa gsum la bsnyengs pa dang bral ba'i mkhas pa yongs kyi 'khor los sgyur ba kun dga' rnam pa gnyis sam/

rje btsun ngor pa dang rdzong pa gnyis su grags pa la sogs pa ste/ rje btsun ngor pa la slob ma bsam gyis mi khyab pa byon pa'i nang nas gtso bor gyur pa ni/ bdag chen gzhi thog pa la sogs pa sa skya 'khon gyi gdung brgyud dang*/ bdag chen ye shes dbang phyug la sogs pa bla brang shar pa rnams dang*/ thugs sras sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan dang*/ rgyal tshab dam pa kun dga' dbang phyug dang*/ yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel ba dang*/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs shes rab rgya mtsho dang*/ mkhas grub dpal ldan rdo rje dang*/ gu ge paṇ+ḍi ta grags pa rgyal mtshan dang*/ gung ru shes rab bzang po dang*/ dwags po bkra shis rnam rgyal dang*/ bzang chen phyogs las rnam rgyal dang*/ smar khams pa grags pa bzang po dang*/ dmar ston rgyal mtshan 'od zer dang*/ paṇ+ḍi ta chen po shākya mchog ldan dang*/ zhwa lu sku zhang mkhyen rab chos rje dang*/ byams chen rab 'byams pa sangs rgyas 'phel dang*/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' chos bzang dang*/ dpal 'bum phrag gsum pa byams pa chos don grub dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' gzhon nu rgyal mchog dang*/ grub chen dkon mchog blo gros dang*/ go bo rab 'byams pa kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge dang*/ nyag re dpal gyi rgyal mtshan dang*/ yon tan 'od zer dang*/ grags pa rin chen don grub dang*/ ldan ma drung kun dga' rin chen la sogs pa dang*/ srad pa kun dga' blo gros dang*/ mkhas grub zla ba bzang po dang*/ brag dkar sems dpa' chen po dang*/ grub thob thang stong rgyal po dang*/ mngon par dga' ba'i mkhan po dpal ldan sangs rgyas dang*/ bla ma dpal ldan rgyal po la sogs pa sa'i steng na yongs su grags pa'i slob ma mang du byon pa rnams dang*/ rim gyis snyan brgyud bstan pa'i bdag po tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho la sogs pa ste/ de dag gi rjes su 'jug pa brgyud pa dang bcas pa rnams kyis rnam pa thams cad du legs par bskyangs so// mdor na 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dge legs dang phan bde'i 'dod dgu mi zad pa'i 'byung gnas gcig pur gyur pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das nyi ma'i gnyen gyi zhal lung dang mngon par rtogs pa'i chos tshul yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i rgyal po 'di nyid/

dzam+bu bṛk+ṣa'i zur phud kyis nye bar mtshan pa'i gling gi dam pa 'di na mkhas pa'i skyes bu gang dag byon pa rnams kyis legs par bshad pa dang tshul bzhin sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo la mnga' gsol te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i phrin las kyi snang ba dkar pos phyogs dang phyogs bral kyi dkyil 'khor thams cad du yang dag par rab tu gsal bar bgyis pa 'di ltar lags so// 'dir smras pa/ sa gsum

mtha' dag gzugs can/ bkra shis byed pa'i cho ga bzo gnas rig pa'i rin chen rgyan gyis rnam par mdzes// rig byed tshe yi bdud rtsi'i dga' ston 'gyed la rab mkhas sgra dang tshad ma'i rdo rje yis// tshig don 'khrul pa'i ri bo'i 'gros bcings nang gi lung don rnam par 'byed pa'i mig stong bkra// yang dag rtogs pa'i lang tsho rtag tu dar la bab rnams blo ldan sngon gyi lha dbang yin// bya ba'i rang bzhin brjod pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa rang gi thugs rje dang*// smon lam gzhal du med las zlos pa'i gar// phyogs bcur chos kyi snang bas 'gengs bzod pa// smra ba'i dbang phyug byon pa bsam mi khyab// chos 'gog pa/ gang dag byon pa de dag stobs bcu pa'i// legs gsungs dri ma med pas 'gro ba la// phan pa bsgrubs pa'i rtogs brjod phyogs re tsam// mthong ba'i nga ro 'byin de ci la snyam// de ko rjes su 'jug pa'i skye bo rnams// chos la blo gros zhum pa gzengs bstod dang*// rgod pa 'dul sogs cha tsam bsnyad pa las// 'phags rnams mdzad pa byis pa'i blo las 'gongs// bsam pa rgya che ba/ gang phyir ston pa thams cad mkhyen pa yi// gnyis su med pa'i ye shes rang snang las// gzhan du bgrang las 'das pa'i bskal pa ru// btsal yang dmigs su med pa nges pa'i don// 'on te blo gros dman pa'i chos kyi blo// 'phyang mo nyug la brten pa spong ba'i slad// 'dri dang len ldon sdud dang 'grel pa yi// rnam par snang bas bstan pa rab gsal byas// rigs rang bzhin brjod pa/ dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen dang brtse// byin rlabs zad mi shes pa'i 'bab stegs su// byas pa mthong na mi mthun med pa'i sku// tshangs bcas skye dgu kun gyis btud pa'i gnas// dgag pa'i dpe/ dngos po thams cad skyon bcu spangs pa'i glu// rtag par 'jo ba'i yon tan gyis dben pas// dri za'i gling bu snyan dgu bsgyur ba'i dpal// smra mchog rnams kyi gsung las shin tu dman//

mdzes pa bsngags pa la sbyar ba/ mtha' klas skye ba'i yun du chos thams cad// sbyangs stobs phun sum tshogs pa'i mkhyen pa des// dpyad pa gang tshe ngal ba'i gtam 'byung ba// ches brling rig pa'i gnas de gang du mchis// mchog gi nges bstan/ e ma chu yi gter las dag byed ma// rtag tu 'byin yang gang ba'i rang bzhin gyis// mkhas btsun bzang po grub pa'i yon tan dag /smra mkhas yongs kyis brjod pas mi zad ston// yan lag gnyis pa'i gzugs can/ gsung rab kun gyi snying po 'doms pa la// mkhas pa'i 'bras bu skal bar ldan pa'i bu// sdug bsngal zhi ba thar pa'i lding khang dang*// thams cad mkhyen pa'i grong khyer song ba mang*// nang shes byed kyi rgyu/ 'gal 'brel rigs par smra la spro ba'i 'dzum// dka' ba'i gnad la brtsad pas ma 'gyur zhing*// phyi rol rgol ba stong gis ma phrogs par// legs par brtags pa'i gtam gyis mgrin pa phyug / dpa' ba phun sum tshogs pa'i zol bstod/ legs bshad brtsams pa'i tshig don zegs mas kyang*// skye 'phags yid kyi brtan pa ma byin par// brtse med rang dbang 'phrog pa'i las 'di 'dra// dge sbyong chos la mi 'os pa min nam// nges pa'i dpe/ mdor na rnam par dkar ba'i phrin las mtha'// mthong 'dod lha yi lam 'dis rang gi lus// sngon por song ba de srid btsal byas kyang*// ma rnyed da dung rjes su song bar nges// thams cad mkhyen pa chen po nyi ma'i gnyen gyi bka' lung spyi dang bye brag gi dgongs don rnam par 'grel pa'i bstan bcos gangs can pa'i skad du 'gyur ro 'tshal gyi chos sbyin rgyun mi chad pa'i ngo mtshar 'phrul gyi phyi mo rdzogs ldan bskal pa'i bsod nams kyi sprin phung rgyas par dkrigs pa'i tshul las brtsams pa'i gtam ngo mtshar chu gter 'phel ba'i zla ba gsar pa las/ spro ba bskyed pa'i ched du bstan skyong rnams kyis bya ba byas pa'i sarga ste gnyis pa'o//
